meta.title: San Jose Sharks — Complexity Course Proposal | LINK Pro
meta.description: Custom two-day lumbo-pelvic-femoral training for San Jose Sharks staff: online prep, hands-on evaluation, and corrective exercise with Dr. Jason Amstutz.

paragraphs: Thanks again for the opportunity to work with you all. I'm really looking forward to getting hands-on with your staff for a custom two-day course focused on the lower limb and lumbo-pelvic-femoral regions.
Here's a breakdown of what I'm proposing, including the structure, topics, and estimated costs.

sections.title: LumboPelvoFemoral focus
sections.body: We'll dive into anatomy, biomechanics, treatment strategies, and corrective exercises for the LPFemoral complex — but before we meet in person, your team will complete a few online courses to lay the foundation.

subsections.title: Pelvis / lumbar spine / femur relationship
subsections.body: We'll take a deep dive into the structural and functional relationships between these regions, with a focus on evaluation strategies and corrective work.
bullets: These three are inseparable: in performance and dynamic movement they move together through innumerable links — ligaments and fascia.
The pelvis is the key to lumbar disc pathology, hip labrum and impingement, adductor tears and sports hernias, and many downstream joint issues at the knee, ankle, and foot.

The sacroiliac joints are highly moveable on a micro scale compared with the iliofemoral joint, and are often overlooked. The layers of information from the SI joint capsule, interosseous and other SI ligaments, and the gluteal layers signify the importance of the pelvis.

prepWork.courseName: Lumbopelvofemoral Complex: The Mobility Command Center of the Body

bullets: Pelvic biomechanics, including oblique axes and inflare/outflare patterns
Key anatomical structures influencing tensegrity and function
Introduction to lesion assessment and correction strategy

Anatomy manuals for each participant (complementary and available ASAP).
Custom technique manual based on the final draft of content.

processNote: Over both days, we'll move from foundational review into practical application — giving your team a complete toolkit for assessment and correction.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Review of key anatomy & biomechanics + hands-on evaluation
bullets: Reinforce key anatomical and biomechanical concepts
Guided evaluation techniques for identifying dysfunction
Begin applying hands-on strategies from prep work: pumping, fascia, 2TLS treatment

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Corrective exercise for common dysfunction patterns
bullets: ELDOA, proprioception drills, and myofascial stretching
Apply strategic corrections for real-world NHL performance issues
Tailored programming based on athlete needs
